subject: PioneerLedger MAP: Security onboarding, SIG/DPA review & retention deadlines
messages:
From: Emma Lambert <emma.lambert@pioneerledger.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: legal@pioneerledger.com, d.ortiz@pioneerledger.com
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 08:14:00 -08:00
Subject: Intro + MAP request: SOC2, SIG/CAIQ & DPA retention alignment

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency profile and the model routing options. We need to formalize a mutual action plan (MAP) so we can complete our Eval/Procurement cycle and meet our internal compliance gates. High-level asks: 

- SOC 2: confirmation of scope (Type II evidence) and ETA for evidence pack.
- SIG/CAIQ: we'll send our questionnaire; want Redwood's CAIQ answers and a short session to walk through any gaps.
- DPA: we're attaching our preferred terms (see Pioneer_DPA_terms.docx) — legal will likely redline. Key commercial point is data retention: we need clarity on retention windows for customer content, logs, and backups.

Target close: end of Q1 — ideally 3/31/2027. Can you propose a MAP with milestones and owners? We'll attach our SIG spreadsheet (Pioneer_SIG.xlsx).

Thanks,
Emma Lambert
Head of Integrations, PioneerLedger
emma.lambert@pioneerledger.com
+1 415 555 0112

Attachments: Pioneer_SIG.xlsx (spreadsheet), Pioneer_DPA_terms.docx (word doc)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Lambert <emma.lambert@pioneerledger.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 12:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + MAP request: SOC2, SIG/CAIQ & DPA retention alignment

Emma — appreciate the clear ask and the timelines. Attached is a first-pass MAP (Redwood_MAP_PioneerLedger_v1.xlsx) that breaks the work into three parallel lanes: Security evidence, Legal/DPA negotiation, and Technical evaluation (test tenant + retention config). Summary of the proposed milestones below: 

1) SIG/CAIQ Q&A and workshop
   - Redwood to complete CAIQ answers and return PDF by 2027-02-28.
   - Joint 60-minute walkthrough week of 3/1 to discuss any controls gaps.

2) SOC 2 evidence pack
   - Confirm scope: Production inference stack (hosted API) + Organized SOC2 report for Data Security + Availability controls.
   - Evidence delivery target: 2027-03-10 (we'll provide the evidence index and sample artifacts; full auditor report requires NDA completion but past Type II reports can be shared under an NDA).

3) DPA negotiation & retention specifics
   - We'll review your DPA terms; please expect a Redwood redline and commentary by 2027-03-04.
   - Proposed retention defaults: customer content cached for up to 30 days in active KV caches, logs/observability retained 90 days by default with 7-year archived backups (industry standard), optional customer-configurable TTLs for longer or shorter windows. We can profile a 30/90/7y default but make retention configurable in the test tenant during the eval.

4) Technical eval & test tenant
   - Jonas will provision a scoped test tenant with synthetic traffic and retention toggles by 2027-02-25.

5) Signoff and contract close
   - Target for contract execution: 2027-03-24; buffer week to remediate any redline items before your internal approvals.

Action items: 
- Ben Carter: lead CAIQ Q&A and security workshop prep.
- Jonas Weber: test tenant + retention configuration.
- Irene: coordinate DPA redline with Legal (cc'ing Laura Bennett for contract review).

If this timeline works, we'll lock the dates and get a weekly 30-min cadence standing through close.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-2123

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_PioneerLedger_v1.xlsx, Redwood_CAIG_QA.pdf

From: David Ortiz <d.ortiz@pioneerledger.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emma Lambert <emma.lambert@pioneerledger.com>, legal@pioneerledger.com
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 09:32:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + MAP request: SOC2, SIG/CAIQ & DPA retention alignment

Irene — thanks for the fast turnaround. A couple of clarifying questions before we lock dates: 

- Retention: the 7-year archived backups is longer than our preference for customer-identifiable content. We need a clearer separation between metadata/logs and customer payload. Can Redwood support a 1-year max for user-generated content backups unless explicitly requested?

- KMS/HSM: we need confirmation that keys are customer-separable. Does Redwood support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) via an HSM/KMS integration for Private deployments? If not, what are the compensating controls for hosted?

- DPA: our legal team redlined the DPA and limited liability caps to 1x fees. We attached the redline (Pioneer_DPA_redline.docx). Please confirm who on your side will review commercial limits.

Quote of your note: 
> Proposed retention defaults: customer content cached for up to 30 days in active KV caches, logs/observability retained 90 days by default with 7-year archived backups (industry standard), optional customer-configurable TTLs for longer or shorter windows.

We'd like to adjust the draft MAP so that retention decisions are an explicit decision point (rather than default assumption). Also, please note we need the CAIQ answers in a format our assessor (third-party) can ingest — Excel preferred.

-David Ortiz
Security Lead, PioneerLedger

Attachment: Pioneer_DPA_redline.docx

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Ortiz <d.ortiz@pioneerledger.com>, Emma Lambert <emma.lambert@pioneerledger.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 15:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + MAP request: SOC2, SIG/CAIQ & DPA retention alignment

David / Emma — great questions. Short answers and next steps below: 

- Retention split: agreed — we'll treat backups containing customer-identifiable content as a negotiable parameter in the MAP. Default we proposed is conservative for infra recovery, but we will add a decision node: "Retention choice A: 1-year backups (customer payload purged), B: 7-year archival (requires explicit sign-off)." Jonas will add this as a config toggle in the test tenant so you can exercise both flows.

- KMS/BYOK: For Hosted (Redwood API) we currently offer provider-managed KMS with envelope encryption and strong key rotation policies + HSM-backed KMS in our cloud provider. For Redwood Private we support customer-managed keys (BYOK) integrated via customer KMS/HSM — we'll document the integration points and provide sample config. Ben will capture the technical note and Laura will review the compliance language for the MAP.

- DPA redline: Laura Bennett (cc'd) will take point on the commercial redlines. Laura: can you review Pioneer_DPA_redline.docx and propose a Redwood response by 2027-03-04? We'll aim to resolve commercial caps during that week.

Revised timeline proposal (slight updates to reflect your redline request):
- 2027-02-25: Scoped test tenant live (Jonas) with retention toggles.
- 2027-02-28: CAIQ (Excel) return + review material (Ben).
- 2027-03-04: Redwood DPA redline & legal commentary (Laura).
- 2027-03-10: SOC2 evidence index + sample artifacts (Irene/Ben).
- 2027-03-17: Final remediation window / any open security controls follow-up.
- 2027-03-24: Contract execution target (final sign-off).

Action items assigned: 
- Ben Carter: CAIQ Excel + security workshop & KMS/HSM technical note (due 02/28).
- Jonas Weber: test tenant with retention toggles (due 02/25).
- Laura Bennett: DPA redline response and commercial review (due 03/04).
- Irene: weekly 30-min MAP cadence; coordinate evidence deliverables.

If that works, I'll schedule the first MAP sync for 02/26 to walk through the MAP and the retention toggle demo.

Thanks — looking forward to progressing.

Regards,
Irene Choi
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-2123

--
Internal note: Ben / Jonas / Laura — please confirm feasibility of dates. I'll open a HubSpot MAP record and attach the Pioneer redline.

Attachments referenced: Pioneer_DPA_redline.docx, Redwood_MAP_PioneerLedger_v1.xlsx
